# capture/ (Document capture — PRD-05 Phases 1, 8, 9)

Four ingestion channels: PWA upload, Postmark inbound email, Twilio WhatsApp WABA, IMAP/Gmail/M365 mirror. AI pipeline posts each event into a supplier invoice.

## Endpoints

### Ingestion (webhooks + PWA)
- `POST /api/accounting/capture/upload` — multipart via `formidable`; stores bytes via `storeCapturedBytes`, creates `captured_documents` + `capture_events` (channel=`pwa`)
- `POST /api/accounting/capture/inbound-email` — Postmark webhook; calls `ingestPostmarkPayload` → `routeEvent` per attachment
- `POST /api/accounting/capture/inbound/whatsapp` — Twilio WABA webhook; parses expense commands, replies via `sendWhatsAppMessage`

### Inbox + config
- `GET /api/accounting/capture/inbox` — pending events with joined extraction (`?status=`)
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/capture/inbox-address` — get / regenerate 6-hex email inbox slug (deactivates prior)
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/capture/whatsapp-inbox` — get / upsert WABA number (E.164 validated); `{ address }`

### Per-event actions
- `POST /api/accounting/capture/[id]/post` — inline AI pipeline; gate-routes via `autoPublishGateService.decide` → `duplicate_blocked` (409) / `route_review` (draft) / `auto_publish` (approved). After insert: `performThreeWayMatch` + `attachEvidenceToProvisional` + `resolvePendingAlertForInvoice`
- `POST /api/accounting/capture/[id]/discard` — body `{ reason? }`; status=`discarded`

### Mirror (PRD-05 Phase 9)
- `GET|POST /api/accounting/capture/mirror` — list / create IMAP-password connection (Gmail/M365 use `/oauth/start`)
- `PATCH|DELETE /api/accounting/capture/mirror/[id]` — update senders/folder/interval / hard-delete (cascades log)
- `POST /api/accounting/capture/mirror/[id]/disconnect` — mark disconnected + wipe creds
- `GET /api/accounting/capture/mirror/[id]/log` — recent scan entries
- `POST /api/accounting/capture/mirror/[id]/scan-now` — one-off scan bypassing interval gate; returns `{ scanned, ingested, skipped, errors }`

## Auth
- User routes: `withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(...)))` for mutating; `withAuth(withErrorHandler(...))` for GET
- **Webhooks no-auth, secret-gated**:
  - `inbound-email`: verifies `X-Postmark-Token` against `POSTMARK_INBOUND_TOKEN` env (rejects when env missing)
  - `inbound/whatsapp`: verifies `X-Twilio-Signature` via `twilio.validateRequest` using `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`
- **Webhooks always return 200** on rejection so provider stops retrying (payload contains `{ rejected: '<reason>' }`)

## Business rules
- `routeEvent` is fire-and-forget — webhook response does not wait for VLM extraction; background task logs its own failures
- `post` is the **single source of truth** for gate decisions — does not re-call gate after another service posted (prevents double-posting)
- Capture event populates `source_document_id` on the created supplier invoice (fixed 2026-04-22)
- Formidable uses `fileWriteStreamHandler` to capture raw Buffer (SHA-256 + Storage upload in one shot) rather than default tmp path
- Twilio signature check requires the EXACT URL — built from `APP_URL ?? NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`; when NEITHER is set the webhook 503s (fail closed, Twilio retries) instead of 403ing every message as "invalid signature"
